name: The Harvester
summary: A severed head found in the southern Barrens brings The Harvester’s strange presence to Camp Taurajo. Jorn Skyseer examines the remains, and the creature’s intrusion raises concerns for the land’s spiritual and ecological balance.

sections.title: An Unnatural Intruder
sections.body: In the southern Barrens, you find the severed head of a silithid called the Harvester. Lions, raptors, and kodos roam these grasslands, but this chitinous insectoid is unlike the native wildlife. Its presence suggests an alien ecology has reached the open plains of Kalimdor.

sections.title: Jorn Skyseer's Premonition
sections.body: At Camp Taurajo, tauren mystic Jorn Skyseer examines the Harvester’s head. The creature’s spirit has already fled, so Jorn cannot divine its origin. He recognizes the remains as a profound threat and fears its intrusion may herald a grim future for the Horde. Darker mysteries are brewing beneath the sands.

aliases: what kind of bug is the harvester
faq.answer: The Harvester is a large silithid insectoid prowling the southern Barrens. Its chitinous form is unlike the region’s native wildlife.

aliases: who is the turn in npc
faq.answer: Jorn Skyseer is a respected tauren elder and spiritual guide at Camp Taurajo. He watches over the plains’ spiritual health and counsels others when the land’s balance is threatened.

faq.q: Where does the Harvester come from?
faq.answer: Jorn Skyseer cannot divine the Harvester’s exact origin from its severed head. The creature comes from the silithid hives spreading up from the deep deserts to the south.

faq.q: Why does the creature disturb Jorn Skyseer?
faq.answer: The Harvester’s unnatural form and foreign spirit deeply disturb Jorn. He senses its presence in the Barrens is no random occurrence, but a warning of an unnatural threat to come.

faq.q: How do you start this quest?
faq.answer: You begin by slaying the rare silithid called the Harvester in the southern Barrens and taking its severed head. Then you seek the elders’ guidance at Camp Taurajo.

faq.q: What does Jorn tell you to do next?
faq.answer: Jorn offers no immediate counterattack. He believes the Horde must prepare and stay vigilant as the mystery of the encroaching silithid slowly unfolds.

angles.text: As a Shu'halo, you know the Earth Mother’s harmony is paramount. An entity that defies the natural order signals deep spiritual disharmony.
As a shaman, you understand Jorn Skyseer’s frustration: the spirit has fled the head, preventing communion with the elemental forces to discover the creature’s true origin.
As a druid, you can see the corruptive, parasitic nature of these alien burrowers invading the savannah.
As a member of the Horde, you know Camp Taurajo guards the Barrens’ southern reaches. An invasive predator in the surrounding bluffs threatens the area’s security.
